cells.note: Housekeeping 76: UNCTAD's 2023 strategy says Seychelles has no entrepreneurship policy or act (SYC-001), so 1 holds. The 2025 Infant Companies Order (SYC-002) is a blanket tax exemption for new firms in three sectors, not a startup law, counted as other.
